answer.rationale: Primary contract lapses in 14 days with no auto-renew while the line sits at 94% with no buffer, so continuity with the incumbent is required to avoid a delivery break (c1). An as-is renew will not hit the mandated 18% spend cut; switching primary (c2) or adding a second source (c3) would spend the only decision slot on onboarding risk this cycle. Prior renewals moved incumbent price and terms via benchmarking, and multi-year volume commitments cut unit cost without narrowing scope (c4, c6). Intend to renegotiate incumbent price/term rather than switch or defer. Verifying c4 as the load-bearing precedent that margin can actually be recovered at renewal. Uncertain whether a full 18% is achievable in 14 days; a failed or slipped negotiation would starve the line.
